I updated `0.html`. It still shows the same black circle, but the page code is cleaner and it works better on small screens. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

- **No stray scrollbars:** it used `100vw`/`100vh`, which can cause scrollbars on some browsers. The page now fills the viewport without them, and it handles mobile browser toolbars properly.
- **Scales on small screens:** the circle used to be fixed at 400px, so it got cut off on narrow phones. It now shrinks to fit (at most 90% of the smaller screen side) and never grows past 400px.
- **Simpler centering:** the body uses CSS grid with `place-items: center` instead of flexbox.
- **Accessibility:** the SVG now has `role="img"` and a `<title>`, so screen readers can announce it.
- **Easier to recolor:** the circle uses `fill="currentColor"`, so you can change its color by setting `color` in CSS.

"Improve" was open-ended, so I kept the design the same and only made technical fixes. If you wanted visual changes like color, animation or a gradient, tell me what you're after.
